title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
task: Real-time long-video generation with multi-step denoising
key_results: 147.6 DiT FPS and 134.8 end-to-end FPS on 8 H200 GPUs; 7.07x single-GPU throughput; Wave Parallelism delivers up to 2.53x throughput over context-parallel baselines
comments: Wave Forcing cleverly overlaps pipeline stages to achieve practical streaming video synthesis, though comparison to Rolling Forcing on quality metrics remains limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chunk-wise causal attention + staggered denoising enables 1F1C (one output per forward round)
hypotheses.result: Achieved with maintained quality comparable to Rolling Forcing

title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
task: Computer-use agent training via nested recursive improvement with open-world data
key_results: CUA-Master-27B: OSWorld Verified 80.2%, OSWorld 2.0 36.9%, WeaveBench 43.9%, Agents' Last Exam 25.0%; continuous gains across recursive iterations; improved data synthesis quality and efficiency
comments: Double-loop framework with visual-semantic trajectory reconstruction is novel, though absolute performance on some benchmarks remains modest.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nested world-data-model and seed-propagation flywheels enable continuous capability expansion
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated through multiple benchmark evaluations

title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
task: Long-horizon multi-agent work coordination with persistent memory
key_results: Competitive performance on 12 benchmarks across 6 real-world application categories; RSI on Qwen3.6-35B improved average score from 33.19 to 42.95 (+9.76 points) over five rounds
comments: CoworkOS separates strategy from execution management effectively, but evaluation primarily compares against Codex/DeepSeek rather than recent open-weight alternatives.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical workspaces + persistent semantic memory enable resumable long-horizon work
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated through multi-round post-training case study

title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
task: Survey of agentic systems in computer graphics with taxonomy and literature analysis
key_results: Unified taxonomy across graphics tasks; agentic literature system for paper-scale analysis; identified coordination, interface design, long-horizon planning, and evaluation as key open challenges
comments: Primarily a position/survey paper providing conceptual framework rather than empirical contributions; valuable for organizing scattered literature but lacks concrete solutions.

title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
task: Agentic video generation, world modeling, and recursive self-improvement
key_results: Framework identifies key capabilities (audiovisual perception, long-horizon planning, memory, feedback-guided control, skill reuse); demonstrates mutual improvement between agents and world models
comments: This is a conceptual position paper identifying research directions rather than presenting empirical results; concrete implementations and benchmarks are limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent harness can coordinate scripting, shot planning, and editing for coherent multi-shot videos
hypotheses.result: Conceptual framework proposed; empirical validation deferred

hypotheses.hypothesis: Game engines can maintain state while video models render observations for mutual evaluation
hypotheses.result: Hybrid design identified as promising but not fully explored

title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
task: Open-weight robot manipulation agents with zero-shot capabilities
key_results: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves RoboDojo Score 31.39 (vs. GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe 28.97); competitive on 19 real-world tasks; identifies four core capabilities for effective robot use
comments: Democratization goal is valuable, but limited analysis of why open models outperform larger proprietary ones on this specific task.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Four general capabilities (perception, reasoning, planning, execution) jointly enable effective robot use
hypotheses.result: Validated across model families and sizes

title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
task: History-guided trajectory collection for coding agent training without train-test mismatch
key_results: SWE-Trail improves mean resolution by 2.33 points on SWE-Bench Multilingual and 1.60 points on Pro vs. independent sampling; history-guided collection outperforms history-conditioned context
comments: Elegant solution separating history's guidance role from model context to avoid distribution shift; however, gains are modest and limited to two benchmarks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: History-guided collection without context exposure avoids train-test mismatch while improving trajectory diversity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2.33 point gain over independent sampling on Multilingual

title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
task: Scaling computer-use agents through integrated experience flywheel and RL
key_results: NorthCUA-Pro achieves state-of-the-art among open-source on GUI grounding, desktop, and web interaction; NorthCUA-Ultrafast offers quality-latency tradeoff; continuous performance gains from experience recycling
comments: Strong empirical results across multiple evaluation settings, though detailed ablations of individual components (staged learning vs. RL contribution) are limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Experience flywheel + recursive self-improvement + staged learning enables sustained scaling
hypotheses.result: Validated across model family and benchmarks

title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
task: Systematic evaluation and improvement of recovery behavior in computer-use agents
key_results: Ideal recovery unlocks latent task completion; current agents fail to exploit recovery capabilities; accurate model-based recovery yields measurable end-to-end gains; transition-consistent recovery formalized as criterion
comments: ReTrace makes an important contribution by formalizing recovery as distinct capability; however, proposed solutions remain mostly analytical rather than algorithmic.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model-based recovery without environment resets can improve long-horizon performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; end-to-end gains demonstrated

hypotheses.hypothesis: Current agents significantly underutilize latent recovery capabilities
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through systematic evaluation

title: PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360^{circ} View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments
task: Composition-aware framing for 360° panoramic scenes with explainable assessments
key_results: Highest average mIoU on two standard 2D cropping benchmarks; blind ranking on 100 panoramas places PhotoGuider first in 53.2% of cases vs. 27.3% and 19.5% for alternatives
comments: Pragmatic two-stage approach combining direction selection and cropping; however, composition token design appears task-engineered rather than learned.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit composition-aware features enable better direction selection in 360° scenes than end-to-end approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through blind ranking study

title: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
task: Priority-guided active video captioning with hierarchical observation planning
key_results: Outperforms open-source baselines on four captioning benchmarks; generated captions better support downstream video QA; context-focus-points (CFP) planning effectively prioritizes visual evidence
comments: The verification-guided trajectory construction is pragmatic, though comparison is limited to open-source baselines rather than frontier models.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit observation planning with GRPO training improves caption quality and evidence relevance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; GRPO with key-fact reward and PAR outperforms baselines

title: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
task: Survey and taxonomy for unified treatment of omnimodal embeddings
key_results: Identifies three progressive capabilities (coverage, transformation; comparability, alignment; compositionality, joint embedding); traces convergence of embedding research across modalities
comments: Valuable position paper proposing unified framework; however, lacks empirical validation of proposed taxonomy or concrete metrics for compositionality.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Embedding research across modalities is converging toward common principles via contrastive learning and Transformers
hypotheses.result: Argued through literature analysis; empirical validation not provided

title: CrossSWE: Benchmarking Cross-Repository Joint Development for Coding Agents
task: Cross-repository software development requiring coordinated changes
key_results: GPT-6.1 Sol achieves 58.48% Pass@1; cross-repository inconsistency is most prevalent failure mode (44.2%); benchmark spans 171 instances, 165 repos, 20 domains, 13 languages
comments: CrossSWE effectively highlights an important blind spot in coding agent evaluation; however, limited analysis of specific failure patterns or ablations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coordinated cross-repository changes are significantly harder than single-repository tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; lower pass rates and cross-inconsistency as dominant failure mode

title: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
task: Separating physical surprise from appearance/motion in video world model predictions
key_results: Appearance remains easy to decode; V-JEPA2 exposes modest physical information; incorrect actions raise prediction error but so do appearance changes; single-frame repetition can exceed original clip error
comments: Important negative result showing latent prediction error is unreliable proxy for physical understanding; however, no solutions proposed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent prediction error reliably measures physical surprise in action-conditioned models
hypotheses.result: Rejected; appearance changes produce substantial errors; impossible events can have lower error than possible events

title: Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents
task: Persistent personal agents amplifying human agency through sustained decision delegation
key_results: Proposes Avatar Intelligence paradigm and Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) metric; identifies three core research challenges (identity-continuous personalization, rehearsal engineering, safety mechanisms)
comments: Important position paper framing agent evaluation around human agency rather than capability alone; however, lacks concrete benchmark or empirical validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Measuring agent value requires AOI metric balancing capability, operational cost, and oversight burden
hypotheses.result: Framework proposed; empirical application deferred

title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
task: Identifying and bridging visual reference gaps in multimodal reasoning
key_results: Task-matched references improve accuracy by up to 25%; mismatched references provide little benefit or hurt performance; reference gap is bottleneck distinct from perception
comments: ReGap-Bench elegantly isolates a specific failure mode; however, proposed solutions remain external aids rather than internal model improvements.

hypotheses.hypothesis: External visual references (numbering, highlighting) can narrow reference gap independent of perception improvements
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; up to 25% accuracy gain with task-matched references

title: FLAMIA: FLAsh MIcroscaling Attention for Fast and Causally Safe Training on Blackwell
task: Fast causal attention training on Blackwell with MXFP8 and mixed precision
key_results: FLAMIA accelerates forward+backward attention by 1.10-1.40x on B200 and 1.06-1.42x on B300 vs. fastest baseline; maintains training stability and model quality
comments: Hardware-software co-design is sophisticated; however, gains are modest and evaluation limited to specific workloads (causal, packed documents).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Token-block scaling + targeted safeguards enable reliable MXFP8 attention without causal leakage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through training stability validation

title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
task: Decision model training via on-policy distillation from generative teacher ranking
key_results: DecisionRank at 1.7B surpasses 27B teacher on TREC DL19-23; at 8B outperforms 27B generative listwise while 24.5x faster on TREC DL and 16.7x faster on BRIGHT
comments: Item-space OPD elegantly bridges gap between teacher's ranking output and student's score representation; speedups are substantial though accuracy tradeoff should be clearer.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Item-space on-policy distillation transfers ranking preferences better than offline supervision alone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent outperformance across TREC DL, BEIR, BRIGHT

title: Measuring AI Agents as Teammates with Collaborative Intelligence
task: Evaluating AI agents as teammates across eight dimensions of collaborative intelligence
key_results: 18 models evaluated; best model scores 82.2/100; all models have weaknesses as teammates; general capability does not guarantee good teamwork (up to 11-point variance at same capability)
comments: Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark addresses important capability gap; however, some tasks (e.g., interpersonal pressure scenarios) may not fully capture real collaboration dynamics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Teamwork capabilities are distinct from individual task-solving capability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 11-point variance at matched capability scores

title: DeFT-RAG: Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers
task: Multi-hop question answering via decomposition with reusable sub-question answers
key_results: DeFT-RAG achieves best accuracy on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, HotpotQA; 23.1% of sub-questions answered from QA cache, reducing LLM calls by 12.9% without accuracy loss
comments: Self-contained sub-questions and QA caching are clever design choices; however, gains over iterative RAG baselines appear incremental.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Self-contained sub-questions eliminate need for dependency planning and rewriting, reducing error
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; best accuracy among 13 baselines

hypotheses.hypothesis: QA caching provides 12.9% LLM call reduction without accuracy loss
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on MuSiQue

title: BYOD: Build Your Own DLM - Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Model Conversion
task: Parameter-efficient autoregressive-to-diffusion language model conversion
key_results: BYOD converts Gemma 2 9B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen2.5 7B, Ministral 8B with 4.1-5.8% parameters; 3.1-4.0 hours on single GPU; BYOD-Gemma reaches 50.6% vs. 51.9% for LLaDA-8B
comments: LoRA-only conversion is practical, but open-generation quality gap (perplexity 8.3-11.1 vs. 2.2-3.0 for AR parents) remains substantial.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LoRA adaptation with diffusion objective enables AR-to-DLM conversion without full retraining
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; four model families converted successfully

title: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
task: Joint video and 3D motion prediction via large-scale pretraining
key_results: WorldFlow achieves lowest ADE/FDE among learning-based methods; on SpatialCog 54.2% ADE reduction vs. strongest baseline; 55.9% ADE and 68.5% FDE reduction vs. flow-only variant; trained on 1.44M samples
comments: Joint video-trajectory prediction is well-motivated; however, evaluation remains largely on simulation (Kubric) with limited real-world robotics validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Jointly predicting video and 3D trajectories couples appearance with geometric dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 54.2% ADE reduction on SpatialCog

title: MAServeBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Serving Systems with Hierarchical Collaboration Workloads
task: Benchmarking multi-agent LLM serving systems with hierarchical collaboration workloads
key_results: MAServeBench captures 8 dimensions of multi-agent collaboration; reveals that serving efficiency does not always correlate with task timeliness; enables reproducible hardware behavior analysis
comments: Addresses real gap in benchmarking multi-agent serving; however, evaluation results on specific systems are limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-agent collaboration generates distinct serving workload patterns not captured by independent request benchmarks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through hierarchical semantic traces

title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
task: Runtime policy enforcement for tool-using agents via Lean4 verification
key_results: LeanGuard blocks 100% of forbidden calls (vs. 33+ for unguarded Qwen models); on Tau-Bench task success unchanged with feedback; reduces prompt-injection success from 57.9% to 5.9%
comments: Formal verification adds strong safety guarantees; however, proof-guided repair succeeds for only 88/252 (35%) denied calls.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lean4-verified policies can prevent policy-violating tool calls with minimal task performance impact
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 100% blocks with no task success drop

title: Self-Improvement with Auxiliary Rewards: Learning from Verified Traces and Evaluating Transfer
task: Small-language-model self-improvement via auxiliary trajectory preferences under limited supervision
key_results: UID-Conj. (entropy-based metric) improves Qwen3-1.7B by 2.08 points on online benchmark and transfer tasks; outperforms confidence-based (SC) on offline weighted SFT; task-dependent benefits
comments: Auxiliary rewards for trajectory quality is well-motivated; however, confidence intervals on some gains overlap zero.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Entropy-based trajectory preferences (UID-Conj.) improve small-model self-improvement more than confidence-based metrics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on online and offline benchmarks, though task-dependent

title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
task: Transferring harness improvements to compact manipulation agents via distillation
key_results: TinyAstral RSI improves teacher from 33.4% to 63.6%; 4B student reaches 62.8%; distilled student outperforms open 4B agents and SenseNova-RoboRSI; ~1/5 teacher compute cost
comments: Clever two-stage approach separating harness evolution from model distillation; however, evaluation limited to RoboTwin with three additional benchmarks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Harness evolution gains transfer to distilled students via frozen teacher trajectories
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; student reaches 62.8% vs. teacher 63.6%

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
task: On-policy self-distillation with continuously evolving teacher for improved supervision quality
key_results: TESD consistently outperforms token-level and sequence-level baselines; improves supervision quality through teacher-oriented optimization and adaptive student weighting; tested across multiple datasets and scales
comments: Teacher evolution is practical improvement over static OPSD; however, absolute performance gains over baselines appear modest.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Evolving teacher quality through environmental feedback improves self-distillation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms representative baselines

title: Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev
task: Assessing and improving cross-primitive consistency in LLM-based decision-making
key_results: Cross-primitive discrepancies predict decision failure with ROC-AUC 0.91; CPRC reduces inconsistency by 58.57% and improves accuracy by +2.97%
comments: Addresses an important but underexplored reliability concern in LLM querying, though the practical impact depends on how prevalent multi-primitive queries are in real applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-primitive inconsistencies follow systematic patterns and predict decision failure
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with ROC-AUC 0.91

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lightweight residual calibration can improve both accuracy and consistency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with 58.57% inconsistency reduction and +2.97% accuracy gain

title: Multi-Agent Relay Thinking
task: Multi-agent collaborative reasoning with dynamic relay topology
key_results: +3.3% on MathVista, +3.9% on MMStar; 6.0x less token overhead than group-thinking strategies
comments: Novel relay topology is intuitive and empirically sound, though the confidence-guided mechanism appears relatively straightforward and may benefit from ablation studies on confidence calibration.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Relay thinking with confidence-guided triggering outperforms independent group thinking
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on four benchmarks with gains up to +3.9% and 6.0x token reduction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heterogeneous agents benefit from progressive integration in relay topology
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through analysis showing complementary insights across reasoning stages

title: TaoMate-FVSR:Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration
task: Audio-guided facial video restoration with audiovisual synchronization
key_results: Achieves best paired perceptual similarity and synchronization scores on talking-head restoration benchmarks; recovers lip contours, dental structure, and facial texture in scene-level footage
comments: Audio conditioning for visual dubbing is well-motivated; however, specific quantitative comparisons to prior methods are absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Audio guidance improves facial restoration quality and synchronization vs. visual-only models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on benchmarks

title: Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?
task: Nonparametric continual learning from tutorial videos without parameter updates
key_results: TAL outperforms all baselines on VidLearn chess benchmark; 113% relative gain vs. vanilla MLLM on training split, 91% on test split; reaches stronger opening position in 69% of head-to-head games
comments: Tutorial learning is practical and scalable; however, evaluation limited to single domain (chess) with 72 videos.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tutorial books with adversarial question refinement enable parameter-free continual learning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on VidLearn; generality unclear

title: Lab2Sim: Turning Real-World Experiment Videos into Interactive Virtual Experiments
task: Converting real-world experiment videos to interactive virtual experiments with enforced preconditions
key_results: Lab2Sim benchmark: 218 videos with 11,881 rubric items; EduVideo2Code improves apparatus fidelity by 24.15 points across backbones; models generate runnable code but struggle with apparatus reconstruction
comments: Lab2Sim addresses interesting educational application; however, current model performance on apparatus fidelity remains modest.

model_io.model: Multimodal model with state machine code generation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical procedure extraction + state machines improve apparatus reconstruction
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; 24.15-point gains but absolute performance still limited

title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
task: Dynamically ordering Transformer layers at runtime for problem-specific computation
key_results: LoL generalizes dense, depth-recurrent, and MoE efficiency tradeoffs; on sudoku/maze uses distinct layer orderings for different strategies; multilingual routing varies by language/script; safety probes achieve high AUROC
comments: Dynamic routing is conceptually interesting; however, concrete performance improvements over static architectures are not clearly demonstrated across all tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic layer ordering enables problem-specific solution strategies
hypotheses.result: Observed on synthetic sudoku/maze; unclear on language tasks

title: ProVe: Proposer-Verifier Decoding
task: Efficient block-based autoregressive token generation via proposer-verifier decoding
key_results: ProVe-lossless with 32B proposer achieves 2.5x AR throughput; ProVe with 3B verifier reaches 2.7x at 2.6 accuracy points below AR; block size 16 has 6.6-token average matching prefix
comments: Reversing speculative decoding is creative; however, 2.6-point accuracy cost for 2.7x speedup represents significant tradeoff.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single forward pass block proposal + verification achieves substantial speedup without training separate draft model
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2.5x lossless speedup

title: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
task: On-policy distillation using ordinal supervision instead of probability matching
key_results: Outperforms OPD on all six teacher-student pairs by up to 2.9 points average, with gains up to 5.6 points on AIME25
comments: Elegant insight that ranking rather than probability values carries transferable knowledge; temperature-invariance is a practical advantage though the mechanism warrants deeper theoretical analysis.

outputs: student predictions respecting teacher token ordering

hypotheses.hypothesis: Teacher token ordering carries sufficient knowledge for effective distillation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: O³PD outperforms probability-matching OPD across all pairs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ordinal supervision is invariant to teacher temperature and requires no tuning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by temperature-invariant design

hypotheses.hypothesis: Departing from teacher probabilities while preserving ranking yields stronger students
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: O³PD reproduces ranking more faithfully than OPD despite larger probability divergence

title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
task: Layer-wise SVD-based LLM compression with improved rank allocation and decomposition
key_results: Zero-shot accuracy gains up to 4.8 p.p.; KFAC-SVD achieves 15% average perplexity improvement; scales to 70B parameters
comments: Addresses two key SVD compression bottlenecks with principled solutions (ILP-based rank allocation, token-wise Fisher statistics), though computational cost of the search procedure could be better characterized.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Layer-wise error modeling with propagation bias enables better rank allocation than global approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: LEMS outperforms existing strategies with up to 4.8 p.p. accuracy gains

hypotheses.hypothesis: Token-wise Fisher statistics mitigate rank collapse compared to global Fisher
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: KFAC-SVD achieves 15% average perplexity improvement

title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
task: End-to-end multimodal deep research agent using rendered document pages instead of OCR text
key_results: Outperforms OCR baselines on GPT-4o, Gemini-3.5-Flash, Qwen3.6-27B; training improves recall by ~15 points and accuracy by >10 points; 1.8 points from oracle on out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3
comments: Strong empirical validation that page-native retrieval is superior to OCR, and counterfactual credit reweighting is an elegant solution to noisy trajectories; 1.06M page corpus evaluation is substantial.

inputs: noisy teacher trajectories with reasoning and action steps
outputs: weighted training signal based on counterfactual contribution

hypotheses.hypothesis: Page-native retrieval and reasoning outperforms OCR-based pipelines without training
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across multiple state-of-the-art VLMs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fine-grained credit assignment improves agentic supervised finetuning on noisy trajectories
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: +15 points retrieval recall, +10 points final accuracy on DRPixelBench

hypotheses.hypothesis: Page-native training generalizes to out-of-distribution settings
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: within 1.8 points of oracle on ViDoRe-V3

title: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
task: Evaluating vision-language models' 3D reasoning consistency and reliability
key_results: Humans achieve 93.3% per-color counting accuracy vs 7.2% for best model; fine-tuning raises one model from 3.0% to 68.6% but reveals inconsistency with own counts; exact reasoning requires visual evidence only 65% of the time for Qwen3.5-27B
comments: Thorough benchmark design with probing analysis reveals critical gaps between recovery and consistent use of properties; the finding that image-removal controls show spurious successes is particularly concerning for deployed systems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: VLMs struggle with per-color counting in 3D scenes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 7.2% best model vs 93.3% human accuracy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Recovering a property does not guarantee consistent use in reasoning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: fine-tuned model recovers counts but remains inconsistent with them

hypotheses.hypothesis: The language model stage loses information despite being recoverable at input
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 65.0% probe recovery vs 3.0% model accuracy on Qwen3.5-27B

hypotheses.hypothesis: Some apparent 3D reasoning successes are not visually grounded
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by image-removal controls

title: SIMIT: Self-Improving Vision-Language Models via Imagination at Test-Time
task: Test-time self-improvement for vision-language models via controlled multimodal data imagination
key_results: SIMIT achieves +7.20% mean relative gain over BAGEL-7B; training-free SIMIT-ICL achieves +6.98%; consistent improvements across 17 diverse benchmarks
comments: Imagining practice examples is clever and training-free; however, difficulty filtering and adaptive budgeting add computational cost not explicitly quantified.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Imagining query-specific practice examples enables test-time self-improvement without external model
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; +7.20% relative gain vs. BAGEL

title: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
task: Improving long-context retrieval in gated linear attention through initialization
key_results: DAMI improves RULER-style retrieval accuracy by 5.29 to 16.71 percentage points across GDN, KDA, GDN2, Mamba-2, RWKV-7; language modeling and reasoning performance remains comparable
comments: Practical initialization technique with broad applicability across linear attention families; the finding that A_log and dt_bias remain correlated with initial values post-training is noteworthy and suggests room for further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint initialization of A_log and dt_bias improves long-context retrieval
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 5.29 to 16.71 p.p. improvements across five architectures

hypotheses.hypothesis: Geometric timescales and input-sensitivity profiles are key to retrieval
hypotheses.result: Supported by DAMI design achieving target behavioral profiles

hypotheses.hypothesis: Improved retrieval does not compromise language modeling or reasoning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: performance remains broadly comparable to baselines

title: When Morphs Look Better: Face Image Quality as a Training-Free Signal for Morphing Attack Detection
task: Face image quality assessment (FIQA) for morphing attack detection (MAD) without morph-specific training
key_results: DifFIQA(R) achieves 11.42% mean D-EER on FRLL; on diffusion-based attacks up to 11/17 methods assign higher quality to morphs than bona fide; performance is attack-dependent
comments: Important finding that quality-based MAD fails on modern diffusion morphs; however, limited solutions proposed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FIQA methods can serve as training-free MAD without attack-specific adaptation
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; varies significantly by attack type

title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
task: Continual harness self-evolution without catastrophic forgetting across multiple task types
key_results: Evolution on subsequent task substantially undermines prior performance (66% relative drop on SWE-Bench after FeatureBench evolution); identifies continual evolution as open problem
comments: Highlights important limitation of current harness evolution approaches; however, no solutions or mitigations proposed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Harness evolution suffers catastrophic forgetting when applied sequentially across tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 66% performance drop after evolution on new task

title: DNA-driven dimerization of Ku70/Ku80 regulates the synapsis of double-strand breaks by APLF
task: Mechanism of APLF-mediated synapsis of double-strand breaks via Ku70/Ku80 dimerization
key_results: APLF requires threading of ≥2 Ku70/Ku80 heterodimers per DNA end for synapsis; long non-coding RNA NIHCOLE cooperatively binds up to 4 Ku70/Ku80 complexes; multivalency restricts bridging to DNA-bound Ku70/Ku80
comments: The threading requirement elegantly explains how multivalent interactions provide both specificity and regulatory control, though in vivo dynamics of lncRNA-mediated regulation remain to be tested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single Ku70/Ku80-APLF interaction is sufficient for synapsis
hypotheses.result: Refuted—requires threading of ≥2 Ku70/Ku80 heterodimers per DNA end

hypotheses.hypothesis: NIHCOLE enhances synapsis efficiency through cooperative Ku70/Ku80 bridging
hypotheses.result: Supported—NIHCOLE binds up to 4 Ku70/Ku80 complexes consistent with bridging model

title: Tracking-free mean square displacement analysis of molecular dynamics
task: Extracting spatiotemporal dynamics of subcellular structures without single-particle tracking
key_results: Image-derived MSD yields simultaneous diffusion coefficients, anomalous exponents, and confinement dimensions; distinguishes Brownian, superdiffusive, and confined motion; resolves object size; temporal resolution ranges from milliseconds (confocal) to microseconds (line-scan)
comments: A practical alternative to tracking that sacrifices trajectory information for robustness in dense environments, though loss of individual-trajectory data limits mechanistic interpretation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fluctuation-based analysis recovers diffusion metrics without discrete trajectory reconstruction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—iMSD extracts diffusion, anomalous exponents, and confinement across temporal scales

title: Reinforcement learning enables autonomous microrobot navigation and intervention in simulated blood capillaries
task: Training reinforcement learning agents for autonomous microrobot navigation in simulated blood capillaries
key_results: RL agents converge on Run-and-Rotate strategies; transferred policies succeed beyond single-condition training; zero-shot transfer demonstrates most failures are optimization limits, not physical constraints; agents achieve targeted vessel blocking/unblocking restoring baseline RBC passage

title: Pattern orientation despite water-induced contrast reduction: a theoretical baseline for ultrafast single-particle X-ray imaging
task: Feasibility of protein structure determination from X-ray diffraction despite water background
key_results: Demonstrated that GroEL (15 nm) structure can be obtained despite reduced contrast and significant water-induced background; orientation algorithms successfully handle faint diffraction patterns enabling phase retrieval
comments: While theoretically sound, practical implementation faces unaddressed challenges from radiation damage and positional jitter that could fundamentally limit real-world application.

title: Phase separation in multi-component membrane during cell adhesion

key_results: Identified key regulatory factors: adhesion protein interactions, thermal fluctuations, protein mobility, external forces, and substrate topography; proposed strategies for controlling phase separation via mechanical and topographical cues

title: Therapy-induced tumour senescence drives oxaliplatin resistance via ADORA1–dependent palmitic acid metabolic reprogramming in colorectal cancer

comments: Reveals therapy-induced senescence as mechanistic link to early acquired chemoresistance via ADORA1-FASN-PA metabolic reprogramming, suggesting senolytic therapy as resistance-reversing strategy.

title: Mechanical stress promotes osteoarthritis progression by increasing miR-145a-5p secretion through Piezo1

title: A document classification benchmark dataset on cybersecurity policy domain
task: Cybersecurity policy document classification benchmark
key_results: XLM-RoBERTa-base achieved 99.99% accuracy and 99.36% F1-score on 1,723 labeled documents (Strategy, Legislation, Guideline)
comments: High performance suggests potential domain saturation; transfer learning on such small benchmark may not generalize to real-world policy variation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: BERT-based models trained on augmented policy data improve classification accuracy
hypotheses.result: XLM-RoBERTa-base outperformed competing BERT variants

title: An integrated deep learning framework for EEG-based sleep disorder detection
task: EEG-based sleep disorder detection via hybrid deep learning
key_results: EB-PSDD framework achieved maximum accuracy 0.949, precision 0.799, NPV 0.971 on CAP Sleep Database using HLNet-P (LeNet + EBN-PCNN hybrid)
comments: Strong reported metrics, but evaluation on single dataset without cross-validation or external test set limits generalization claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid LeNet-PCNN architecture with enhanced batch normalization improves EEG sleep-disorder detection
hypotheses.result: EB-PSDD outperformed traditional methods with maximum accuracy 0.949

title: Predicting short-term mortality in sepsis-associated acute kidney injury: an explainable machine learning model with a web-based prototype
task: Short-term mortality prediction in sepsis-associated AKI via explainable machine learning
key_results: Logistic regression selected as final model: test AUC 0.765 (95% CI 0.706–0.824) with nine LASSO-selected predictors; SOFA_CRRT and serum creatinine most important; GNRI showed nonlinear association (risk spike below 75)
comments: Practical clinical tool with web deployment; suboptimal calibration (p=0.004) acknowledged but limits reliability for risk stratification.

model_io.model: Logistic regression + LASSO feature selection + SHAP interpretation
inputs: 773 S-AKI patients on CRRT with 25 candidate variables

hypotheses.hypothesis: GNRI shows nonlinear association with S-AKI mortality, with threshold effect below 75
hypotheses.result: SHAP analysis revealed pronounced nonlinearity; risk increased sharply when GNRI < 75, protective association above 90

title: Emotion-modulated interaction regression predicts static facial blendshape scores
task: Emotion-modulated facial blendshape-score prediction for virtual avatars
key_results: EMIRA reduced RMSE by 14.07% over rule baseline and 4.44% over image-only regression; 83.90% of per-dimension error reduction concentrated in mouth controls
comments: Task-specific contribution modest; framework measures agreement with automatic MediaPipe scores rather than independent animation quality, limiting practical validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Class-conditioned interaction features improve static blendshape-score prediction over image-only regression
hypotheses.result: EMIRA reduced RMSE by 4.44% vs image-only; gains concentrated in mouth blendshapes

title: Pangenome-based design of a multi-epitope vaccine candidate against Streptococcus pasteurianus with computational evaluation of TLR1–TLR2 interaction
task: Multi-epitope vaccine design for Streptococcus pasteurianus via pangenome and immunoinformatics
key_results: MEV design (344 amino acids) comprising 6 CTL, 4 HTL, 3 LBL epitopes showed favorable TLR1–TLR2 binding (Kd 1.3×10⁻²⁴ M, MM/PBSA −32.15/−16.83 kcal/mol); estimated 76.87% global population coverage; in silico immune analysis predicted enhanced IgG and prolonged cytokine response
comments: Comprehensive computational vaccine design; however, all findings in silico—experimental immunogenicity and protection remain entirely unexplored.

model_io.model: Pangenome analysis + subtractive proteomics + epitope prediction + MD simulations + docking

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-epitope vaccine design targeting conserved core genes elicits broad immune response
hypotheses.result: In silico analysis predicted favorable MEV-TLR interaction, enhanced IgG response, and 76.87% population coverage

title: SABi-YOLO: static axial-bias modelling improves the localization of elongated PCB defects
task: PCB defect localization via static axial-bias YOLO
key_results: SABi-YOLO achieved mAP50–95 of 0.7516 ± 0.0216 with mean improvement of 0.0613 over YOLOv8m; 5.42% fewer parameters and 6.44% fewer GFLOPs
comments: Modest improvement with strong inductive bias; generalization to other datasets not demonstrated, limiting practical deployment confidence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Directional inductive bias improves PCB elongated-defect localization at strict IoU thresholds
hypotheses.result: SABi-YOLO showed consistent improvement over YOLOv8m; DSConv control did not

title: Integrative transcriptomic and machine-learning analysis reveals shared molecular signatures linking osteoporosis and atherosclerosis
task: Shared molecular signatures linking osteoporosis and atherosclerosis via integrative transcriptomics
key_results: 2,788 shared candidates identified; 88 met stringent differential-expression criteria in both diseases; C1orf174, FBXL18, RBM4B prioritized by machine learning; nine-gene panel partially validated (C1orf174 FDR=0.0429 in GSE56815)
comments: Multi-omic integration identified candidates; however, clinical RT-qPCR findings were weak, suggesting identified candidates may be correlative rather than causative.

model_io.model: WGCNA + machine learning (LASSO, random forest, SVM-RFE)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bone and vascular tissues share dysregulated molecular pathways in aging-related diseases
hypotheses.result: 88 genes significantly dysregulated in both OP and AS; functional enrichment implicated translation, endosomal-lysosomal biology, and ECM remodeling

title: Canonical correlation analysis identifies single nucleotide polymorphism combinations and gene expression associated with membranous nephropathy
task: SNP-gene expression associations in membranous nephropathy via multivariate CCA
key_results: CCA identified 1095 HLA and 46 PLA2R1 SNPs significantly correlated with MN; ATF6B, C2, CYP21A2, HLA-DRB1 colocalized with HLA SNPs and showed differential expression in MN; previously unreported candidates for MN and type-1 diabetic nephropathy
comments: Multivariate approach identified gene-SNP interactions; however, small independent validation cohort and modest FDR-corrected signal limit clinical confidence.

model_io.model: Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) + WGCNA + colocalization analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multivariate SNP combinations show stronger correlation with MN transcriptome than univariate GWAS
hypotheses.result: CCA identified 1141 SNPs in HLA/PLA2R1 with MN correlation; functional enrichment and colocalization revealed candidate genes including ATF6B and RNF5

title: A translational bioethical & implementation framework for the use of artificial intelligence in cardiovascular medicine
task: Bioethical framework for AI integration in cardiovascular medicine
key_results: No quantitative results; review identifies four bioethics pillars (autonomy, beneficence, nonmaleficence, justice) overlapping with regulatory requirements; proposes governance priorities for responsible AI deployment in cardiology
comments: Thoughtful ethical analysis; however, framework remains largely conceptual with limited concrete recommendations for translating principles into practice.

title: Comparative assessment of genomic, phenomic, and metabolomic prediction models in biparental grapevine breeding populations
task: Comparative omics-prediction benchmarking for grapevine breeding trait selection
key_results: Genomic (SNP) prediction most accurate (r up to 0.83), metabolomic intermediate (r up to 0.59), phenomic lowest (r up to 0.39); multi-omics integration limited overall gains; genomic selection identified as primary approach for trait prediction in biparental population
comments: Rigorous benchmarking across multiple omics layers; metabolite heritability advantage suggests targeted metabolomic screening may suit specific traits, contradicting broad integration dismissal.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Genomic selection outperforms metabolomic and phenomic prediction for grapevine breeding traits
hypotheses.result: Genomic prediction r up to 0.83; metabolomic r up to 0.59; phenomic r up to 0.39; multi-omics integration yielded limited gains

title: Chromosomal location reprograms genetic circuit function
task: Determine how chromosomal position reprograms genetic circuit dynamics and function
key_results: Spatial positioning alone switches circuits between distinct operational modes; mathematical model predicts three functional regimes for toggle switch linked to chromosomal position via expression noise; 219 circuits tested across four topologies
comments: Elegant decoupling of position effects from sequence; mechanistic attribution to noise-driven stochasticity is valuable, though model validation uses the same experimental dataset.

model_io.model: Bacterial genetic circuits (regulatory cascades and toggle switch)
Mathematical predictive model of toggle switch

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chromosomal position modulates circuit performance through position-dependent effects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: spatial positioning switches circuits between different dynamics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Position effects are mediated by changes in expression noise rather than simple analog changes
hypotheses.result: Supported: mathematical model links chromosomal position to switch stability via noise
